items.summary: KKR (NYSE:KKR) plans to sell a majority stake in specialty insurer Canopius to Samsung Fire & Marine Insurance, while keeping a minority holding. The Canopius deal links KKR with a large Asian insurance partner, creating scope for future collaboration across underwriting and capital solutions.
